sources.title: feat(frames): show inherited Frames in conversation details
sources.text:
Pull request #310: feat(frames): show inherited Frames in conversation details
Merged: 2026-06-02T09:12:00Z into main
Commits from this pull request in the release range:
- a10f3c2 feat(frames): show inherited Frames in conversation details (#310)

Closes #301.

Conversation details listed only the Frames a user added by hand, so people could not see which company or team Frames were also shaping the answer.

## What this does

The **Conversation details** panel now has an **Inherited Frames** section. It lists every Frame the conversation inherits, grouped by where it comes from (Hubspace, team, or project), with each Frame's version.

Inherited Frames are read-only in this panel. Removing one still happens in **Settings → Frames**.

## Verification
- `npm run check` passes
- 4 new component tests for the grouped list

sources.title: fix(connectors): retry the GitHub connector when a token refresh times out
sources.text:
Pull request #312: fix(connectors): retry the GitHub connector when a token refresh times out
Merged: 2026-06-03T14:40:00Z into main
Commits from this pull request in the release range:
- b21e4d3 fix(connectors): retry the GitHub connector when a token refresh times out (#312)

Closes #305.

When the token refresh request timed out, the GitHub connector gave up and showed **Disconnected** until the user signed in again.

The connector now retries the refresh up to three times before it reports a problem. If all three attempts fail, it shows **Sign in again** instead of **Disconnected**, so the next step is clear.

Tested on macOS, Windows and Linux.

Merged: 2026-06-04T11:05:00Z into main
Commits from this pull request in the release range:
- c32f5e4 fix(ops): mark a cancelled Op run as Cancelled in History (#314)

Cancelling an Op run stopped the work but left the run marked **Running** in History forever.

Cancelled runs are now marked **Cancelled** in History as soon as the Op stops.

Known issue: a run cancelled while Collab is offline still shows **Running** until Collab reconnects to the Hub. Tracked separately in #320.

Pull request #318: fix(windows): port the per-user installer fix (#309) to main
Merged: 2026-06-06T08:45:00Z into main
Commits from this pull request in the release range:
- a76d9c8 fix(windows): port the per-user installer fix (#309) to main (#318)

Cherry-pick of #309, which merged to `release/1.2` on 2026-05-20 and shipped in 1.2.1.

## Why this is needed on `main`

`main` still asks for administrator rights when the user picks a per-user install on Windows. Without this port, the next release from `main` would bring the prompt back.

No new behavior compared with 1.2.1.
